source.title: LLM agents work for their parent companies, not for you
source.author: surprisetalk

title.en: LLM Agents: Who Do They Serve?

excerpt.zh: LLM代理能替用户完成任务，但其行为也受开发公司的政策约束。一篇音乐发现案例提出疑问：代理的选择究竟优先服务用户，还是模型提供方的规则与利益？
excerpt.en: LLM agents can act on a user's behalf, but company policies shape what they will do. A music-discovery example raises a central question: whose interests guide an agent's choices?

disclosure.zh: 本文使用星期天AI中转站大模型，基于 Hacker News 内容自动生成。
disclosure.en: This article was automatically generated by the Weekly Day AI gateway model using content from Hacker News.

text.zh: LLM代理可以替用户串联不同网站与任务，但它并非完全由用户掌控。Michael Harley讲述，他用 Claude Code 制作了一个工具：从 Instagram 短视频识别歌曲，再查找乐队的 Bandcamp 页面，方便他购买音乐并下载到自己的设备。
text.en: LLM agents can connect tasks across websites, but users do not have complete control over them. Michael Harley describes building a Claude Code skill that identifies songs in Instagram reels and looks for the artists on Bandcamp, so he can buy music and download it to his own devices.

text.zh: 音乐搜索案例暴露代理边界
text.en: A music search reveals an agent's limits

text.zh: 当 Bandcamp 的搜索接口出现验证挑战后，这个流程失效。作者称，助手表示不会协助绕过挑战；然而，他的另一个分支却能从 YouTube 查找歌曲并按要求下载。作者因此质疑：当代理拒绝某项操作、却允许另一项可能不利于音乐人收入的操作时，规则究竟如何划定？他同时明确表示，自己并未打算绕过 Bandcamp 的挑战。
text.en: The workflow stopped working after Bandcamp added a challenge to its search interface. Harley says the assistant declined to help get around it, while another branch of his tool could find a song on YouTube and download it on request. That contrast led him to question how an agent's rules are drawn when one action is refused but another, potentially less supportive of artists, is allowed. He also makes clear that he did not intend to bypass Bandcamp's challenge.
Who sets the rules for LLM agents?

text.zh: 这篇文章的重点不只是一次拒绝，而是用户对代理忠诚对象的疑虑。模型由公司提供，公司的安全政策会限制它的行为；作者担心，这些限制未来也可能影响搜索结果与建议，使商业利益或外部要求左右用户看到的信息。他因此希望研究在家中运行的本地模型，以及开放模型的含义。
text.en: The article's broader concern is not a single refusal but who an agent ultimately serves. Company policies constrain models, and Harley worries that future recommendations or search results could also be shaped by commercial interests or outside pressure. He is interested in running models locally and in understanding what open models actually provide.

text.zh: 不过，这个个案并不能证明模型已经受到广告操控，也不能说明本地或开放模型就没有偏见、限制或其他风险。不同模型的训练方式、治理规则与实际能力仍需具体考察。文章提出的关键问题仍值得追问：用户能否看清代理为何拒绝、依据哪些规则行事，以及这些规则如何影响任务结果？
text.en: The example does not prove that models are already manipulated by advertising, nor that local or open models are free of bias, restrictions, or other risks. Training methods, governance rules, and capabilities need to be assessed model by model. The central question remains practical: can users understand why an agent refuses, what rules guide it, and how those rules shape the result?
